ns2:course.label: Computer Architecture
ns2:course.description: (ECE 412) Advanced concepts in computer architecture; design, management, and modeling of memory hierarchies, stack-oriented processors, associative processors, pipelined computers, and multiple processor systems; and focuses on hardware alternatives in detail and their relation to system performance/cost. Same as CSE 521. Prerequisite: ECE 411 or CS 433 or consent of instructor
